inspection_notes: Personally viewed all 4 actual JPEGs (F1 688x506, F2 750x544, F3 769x1028, F4 675x1797) with magnified crops of F2A/B, F3C-H and F4A/C. Recorded all 19 panels (F1 A-D, F2 A-D, F3 A-H, F4 A-C): modality, arrows/outlines, scale bars (200 um, 200 um, 5 mm, 250 um), absence of printed SUV values/color scales, unlabeled ruler ticks in F4A, uncircled extra PET foci, and that F3B is PET-CT and F3C is CT per caption (body text cites 3B as CT). Microperforation/abscess in F2B and renal-vein invasion in F3C could not be independently verified in pixels and are held as caption claims. F3 F-H show no focal uptake/node cluster; panel C of F4 is not stated to be the boxed region of F4B. Attribution: F1=p1, F2=p2, F3/F4=p3 from caption plus narrative figure references; specimens F1D/F2D/F4A-C as patient_specimen.
